scope: Saved original legal unique-stock pending candidates at CLOSE; numerical feature/rank sidecar only, no account, fund allocation, execution or PnL simulation.

windows.strong: 2025-07-01..2026-06-30 original calendar; 2025H1 unavailable in this candidate source

common_group: Only candidates with finite original PVR, RS20, prior20-close-high gap and two-block low improvement. All missing candidates remain in output with UNKNOWN; no widening of industry or original candidate set.
percentile: (average ascending rank - 1)/(n - 1); ties get average, not fictitious unique percentiles. Round original PVR to 12 decimals as actual native priority key. Residuals rounded to 12 decimals only for numerical tie handling.
RS20: Existing export: C_t/C_a-1 minus sectorClose_t/sectorClose_a-1; a is the stock's preceding20 valid-observation anchor, exact same-sector endpoints, same valid industry block. Not a reconstructed PIT industry index.
p: within common group percentile of round12 original PVR
q: within common group percentile of RS20
primary_fit: b=max(0,sum((p-pmean)*(q-qmean))/sum((p-pmean)^2)); a=qmean-b*pmean; epsilon=q-a-b*p. Zero PVR variance => UNKNOWN, no arbitrary residual.
residual_percentile: within same common group percentile of round12 epsilon

structure_inputs.low_improvement: min(C_t,...,C_{t-4})/min(C_{t-5},...,C_{t-9})-1; same original PVR validity/block clock, historical source includes pre2022 warmup

structure_percentile: Rank each structure input in same common group; average their two percentiles with equal weights; rank that average again in the same group. This is path-shape information from the same prices, not an independent data source.
baseline_comparisons: diagnostic naive same weights using q instead of residual
one predeclared form check: isotonic PAVA q on p, same group and weights; not an alternative selected using outcomes
ordering: Descending S, tie native H1 numeric key then sid. Report sector-local rank. Any hypothetical pending slot is obtained only by permuting already occupied original PVR slots of this same-sector common group; all other stocks, industries and unknown slots stay fixed. Do not globally compare within-sector S to silently change industry allocation.

fixed_cases.000620.SZ: all original candidate dates in 2022 Jan, plus 2022-09-28 for numeric-key ambiguity

limitations: Static stock universe and industry assignment are nonPIT.
Original pending set depends on the old account path; this does not identify candidates a new account would produce.
No future outcomes enter feature, fit, cohort membership or thresholds.
Known historical cases are consumed research examples, not out-of-sample validation.
Cross-sectional residual is not evidence of independent alpha or profitability.
